summary: The Associate Big Data Engineer works on entry-level data engineering tasks, supporting data processing, transformation, and system monitoring activities.
responsibilities: Support development of data workflows and pipelines
Assist in data ingestion and transformation tasks
Monitor data jobs and report issues
Work closely with senior engineers to gain hands-on experience

Internship or academic project experience in data engineering
